name: Giallo Horror
taste: Loves Italian GIALLO horror (Argento's Suspiria, Deep Red, Tenebrae — black-gloved killers, lurid color, baroque set-pieces). Dislikes generic American slasher and supernatural ghost films. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Splatter Gorehound
taste: Loves over-the-top SPLATTER horror-comedy (Evil Dead 2, Braindead/Dead Alive, Re-Animator). Dislikes slow-burn atmospheric horror and supernatural. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Found-Footage Horror
taste: Loves FOUND-FOOTAGE horror (The Blair Witch Project, Paranormal Activity, REC, Cloverfield). Dislikes glossy studio horror and period costume drama. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Mecha Anime
taste: Loves MECHA anime (Neon Genesis Evangelion, Gundam, giant-robot pilots). Dislikes cute pastoral hand-drawn Ghibli and romance. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Stop-Motion Animation
taste: Loves STOP-MOTION animation (Coraline, Kubo and the Two Strings, Wallace & Gromit, Fantastic Mr. Fox). Dislikes CGI-blockbuster animation. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Spaghetti Western
taste: Loves SPAGHETTI WESTERNS (Leone's The Good the Bad and the Ugly, Once Upon a Time in the West, Django). Dislikes modern superhero action and horror. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Classic Film Noir
taste: Loves 1940s-50s CLASSIC FILM NOIR (Double Indemnity, The Maltese Falcon, Out of the Past — chiaroscuro, femme fatales). Dislikes modern neon neo-noir and action. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Fincher Psych-Thriller
taste: Loves grounded PSYCHOLOGICAL THRILLERS (Se7en, Zodiac, Prisoners, Gone Girl — methodical, dark, no supernatural). Dislikes supernatural horror and broad comedy. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Disaster Spectacle
taste: Loves DISASTER films (Twister, The Day After Tomorrow, 2012, San Andreas). Dislikes quiet character dramas and romance. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Courtroom Drama
taste: Loves COURTROOM dramas (12 Angry Men, A Few Good Men, The Verdict, A Time to Kill). Dislikes action and fantasy. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Coming-of-Age Indie
taste: Loves COMING-OF-AGE indie dramas (Lady Bird, Boyhood, Stand By Me, Call Me By Your Name). Dislikes loud action and horror. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Cosmic Sci-Fi Epic
taste: Loves grand COSMIC SCI-FI EPICS (Interstellar, Dune, Contact, 2001 — awe, scale, ideas). Dislikes campy space opera (Guardians) and superhero. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Creature Feature
taste: Loves CREATURE FEATURES — natural/animal monsters (Jaws, Tremors, The Descent, Crawl). Dislikes supernatural ghost horror and giant city-stomping kaiju. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Le Carre Spy
taste: Loves slow CEREBRAL ESPIONAGE (Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy, The Spy Who Came in from the Cold, Bridge of Spies). Dislikes flashy Bond/Mission-Impossible action-spy spectacle. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Wuxia Poet
taste: Loves poetic WUXIA (Hero, House of Flying Daggers, Crouching Tiger — wirework, painterly). Dislikes gritty modern MMA brawlers (The Raid). Neutral elsewhere.

name: Black Comedy
taste: Loves DARK / BLACK COMEDY (In Bruges, Fargo, Burn After Reading, Three Billboards). Dislikes broad slapstick and gross-out. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Holiday Christmas
taste: Loves feel-good CHRISTMAS movies (Elf, Home Alone, The Holiday, Love Actually). Dislikes horror and bleak drama. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Epic High Fantasy
taste: Loves EPIC HIGH FANTASY (The Lord of the Rings, The Hobbit, Willow — grand quests, good vs evil). Dislikes grimdark and modern superhero. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Slow Cinema Arthouse
taste: Loves SLOW arthouse cinema (Tarkovsky's Stalker, Bela Tarr, contemplative long takes). Dislikes fast blockbusters and comedy. Neutral elsewhere.

name: Erotic Thriller
taste: Loves 90s EROTIC THRILLERS (Basic Instinct, Fatal Attraction, Body Heat). Dislikes gore horror and fantasy. Neutral elsewhere.
